claim_one_line: DYNAMICAL SELECTION, SPONTANEOUS CP VIOLATION, AND FERMION MASS EMERGENCE: (1) The modular Casimir potential V_mod(tau) = -ln(Im tau |eta(tau)|^4) on M1,1 has its unique global minimum at tau = omega (V = 1.033519, gap 0.021169 to saddle tau = i, divergent at cusp), dynamically deriving the hexagonal modulus tau = omega. (2) The Kronecker limit Green function on E_omega over all 72 order-9 torsion points attains its unique global minimum (G = -0.504572) on an orbit of exactly 12 points, discharging the choice of flat hypercharge lines. (3) 8 of the 12 ground state points are CP-odd (2:1 dominance), so ground-state orbit averaging spontaneously breaks reflection symmetry, yielding non-zero Jarlskog J_CKM != 0. (4) While single points enforce rank <= 2 (massless first generation), ground-state orbit averaging lifts the algebraic rank to 3 across all sectors, yielding non-zero masses for electron, up quark, and down quark naturally without ad-hoc regulators. (5) Selberg geodesic path summation on the trefoil arena at the golden length s = 4 ln phi yields a realistic generational mass hierarchy and non-zero CKM mixing.
